correctness.rationale: For 3k+d=9 (k,d>=1), only (1,6) or (2,3). Under A1,D4,A5 allowed singularities, lct>=2/3 and Talar/Dimca–Sernesi syzygy bound force free exponents (4,4), tau=48. Bézout and Tjurina imply n2+4n3+5t5=48, n2+3n3+3t5=9 binom(k,2)+3kd+binom(d,2). Applying Talar Theorem 2.2 eliminates one-cubic t=6, leaving (0,7,4),(3,5,5); flex-contact consumption bounds line-only triples <=4, cubic+two-lines triples <=binom(6-t,2), excluding both. With two cubics, t5=8 or 9; t5=8 requires u,v=(2,6) or (3,5), and only <=1 line-only triple remains, contradicting n3=2. Thus only (2 cubics, 3 lines; n2,n3,t5)=(3,0,9), u=3,v=6 is NECESSARY. Independently re-enumerated all integer arithmetic profiles under inequality, agreeing exactly with 4 Talar profiles, and checked incidence subcases. No existence/freeness sufficiency asserted.
residual_risks: The freeness syzygy and orbifold inequality are accepted published external theorems; independent verification does not reproduce those geometric proofs; outside allowed singularities unclassified.
